note: Defects verified by the reviewer against the pristine source (or by running the probe) in the 2026-10-25 head-to-head. `verified` = reproduced | source | plausible. `keywords` are deliberately specific: a keyword that appears in every report measures nothing. Matching is on finding LINES only, so prose that mentions a term does not earn recall.

defects.title: A project named '..' resolves to the user-data root; Remove Project rmtrees models, settings and every other project
Multi-voice Piper installs are unusable: every archive extracts into the same folder and the per-voice folder is never created (_organize_voice receives a list)
Two wx.App instances on first launch (terms dialog creates one, main() creates another) → teardown crash
Addon compatibility gate compares min_app_version against a hardcoded 0.1.0 while the app is 2026.3.7
set_accessible_name is unguarded off Windows — control.GetAccessible() raises on macOS/Linux
np.load(..., allow_pickle=True) on voice-clone reference audio
Concurrent project.json read-modify-write loses completed segments (load outside the lock)
A failed venv probe caches 'not installed' for 300 s and overrides disk truth
No integrity verification on updates/models/runtimes/FFmpeg; packaging unsigned
TERMS_VERSION (2026.3.1) vs APP_VERSION (2026.3.7): the re-accept-after-update promise never fires
Corrupt archive raises tarfile.ReadError, not DownloadError; bad bytes re-download forever
Resume overwrites processed_text.json with only the new segments
DAISY audio URIs are not XML-escaped
EPUB hrefs are not URL-decoded / fragment-stripped, so valid EPUBs read as empty
Even-length cp1252 text decoded as UTF-16 (codec order tries utf-16 before cp1252)
HTML parser ignores the declared charset and replaces non-UTF-8 bytes
GUI test suite is not portable / order-dependent (125 failures)
Downloads ignore 206 vs 200; a Range-ignoring server appends a full body; 416 bricks .part
settings.json written non-atomically; truncation silently reverts to defaults
Shallow settings merge drops nested defaults (recording.pitch becomes None)
SynthesisWorker.done_count returns the start index
An unparsable min_app_version (e.g. 1.0.0-beta) is treated as compatible
